name: Scandinavian, Alekhine, Pirc & Systems
summary: Unconventional and fiercely combative defenses (Scandinavian, Alekhine, Pirc, Modern, Dutch Defense, London System, Trompowsky), allowing Black and White to bypass main line theory.

subVariations.name: Scandinavian Defense: 3...Qa5 Main Line
subVariations.description: Black challenges e4 on move 1 with 1...d5, brings the queen to a5, and develops the light-squared bishop outside the pawn chain.
subVariations.whitePlan: Castle queenside, attack with Nd5/Qe2, exploit Black's queen moves.
subVariations.blackPlan: Pin f3 knight with ...Bg4, coordinate smoothly on kingside, maintain solid structure.

subVariations.name: Scandinavian Defense: 3...Qd6 (Tiviakov System)
subVariations.description: Sergei Tiviakov's modern weapon: Black retreats the queen to d6, controlling central squares and castling queenside quickly.
subVariations.whitePlan: Develop aggressively with Bf4 and Rd1, put pressure on Black's d6 queen.
subVariations.blackPlan: Castle long, attack d4 with ...Nc6/Qb4, exploit open central files.

subVariations.name: Scandinavian Defense: 3...Qd8 Classical Line
subVariations.description: The ultra-solid retreat 3...Qd8, giving White development in exchange for an impenetrable pawn shield.
subVariations.whitePlan: Storm kingside with Ne5, g4, and h4 to trap Black's bishop on g6.
subVariations.blackPlan: Counter in the center with ...Nbd7 and ...Bb4, defuse White's kingside storm.

subVariations.name: Scandinavian Modern: 2...Nf6 (Portuguese & Icelandic)
subVariations.description: Black delays capturing on d5 with 2...Nf6, leading to sharp dynamic imbalances and gambit lines.
subVariations.whitePlan: Advance c4/c5 to squeeze Black's knights, pressure d5.
subVariations.blackPlan: Fianchetto on g7, anchor knight on d5, undermine center with ...b6.

subVariations.name: Alekhine's Defense: Modern Variation (4.Nf3)
subVariations.description: Alexander Alekhine's provocative 1...Nf6! White attacks the knight, while Black lures White's pawns forward to undermine them.
subVariations.whitePlan: Control center with e5 wedge, maintain active bishop on b3.
subVariations.blackPlan: Fianchetto on g7, trade pawns on e5, anchor knight on d4.

subVariations.name: Alekhine's Defense: Four Pawns Attack
subVariations.description: White pushes four pawns (c4, d4, e5, f4) aggressively, leading to sharp tactical fireworks.
subVariations.whitePlan: Advance d5 to blow open lines, mate the black king.
subVariations.blackPlan: Attack White's overextended center with ...Nb4, target c2 and d5.

subVariations.name: Alekhine's Defense: Exchange Variation (4.d4 d6 5.exd6)
subVariations.description: White simplifies with 5.exd6, entering a balanced queenless middlegame.
subVariations.whitePlan: Control d5 and c-file, utilize spatial advantage on queenside.
subVariations.blackPlan: Use open d-file with ...Rxd8, fianchetto on g7, break with ...e5.

subVariations.name: Pirc Defense: Austrian Attack (4.f4)
subVariations.description: White builds a massive three-pawn center with e4, d4, and f4, met by Black's ...Na6-b4 counterplay.
subVariations.whitePlan: Advance e5 to crush Black's kingside, use Bd3/Kh1 setup.
subVariations.blackPlan: Anchor knight on b4, undermine center with ...c5, pin with ...Bg4.

subVariations.name: Pirc Defense: Classical System (4.Nf3)
subVariations.description: Anatoly Karpov's positional approach: White develops harmoniously with Be2 and O-O, maintaining spatial control.
subVariations.whitePlan: Maintain e4/d4 center, restrict Black's counterplay, control open files.
subVariations.blackPlan: Coordinate with ...Qc7 and ...Re8, strike centrally with ...e5.

subVariations.name: Pirc Defense: 150 Attack (4.Be3 c6 5.Qd2)
subVariations.description: White plays a Yugoslav-style attack with Be3, Qd2, and g4, while Black counters on the queenside with ...b5.
subVariations.whitePlan: Castle long, push h4-h5, mate the black king.
subVariations.blackPlan: Storm queenside with ...b5, place knight on b6, attack White's king.

subVariations.name: Modern Defense: Standard Averbakh System
subVariations.description: Black delays developing the knight to f6, aiming for direct central counterplay with ...e5 and ...f5.
subVariations.whitePlan: Deliver check with Qh5+, exploit Black's uncastled king.
subVariations.blackPlan: Shelter king on f8, attack White's queen with ...Nf6, dominate dark squares.

subVariations.name: Modern Defense: Gurgenidze System (3...c6 4.f4 d5)
subVariations.description: Black locks the center with ...d5 and ...c6, maneuvering the knight to f5 and trading the light-squared bishop.
subVariations.whitePlan: Control space on kingside, prepare f5 break.
subVariations.blackPlan: Anchor knight on f5, trade light bishops with ...Bg4, maintain iron fortress.

subVariations.name: Dutch Defense: Leningrad Main Line (7...Qe8)
subVariations.description: The ultimate dynamic fighting weapon: Black combines the Dutch 1...f5 with a King's Indian fianchetto, playing for an explosive ...e5 break.
subVariations.whitePlan: Break open the queenside with b4-b5, control central d5 square.
subVariations.blackPlan: Advance ...e5, mobilize pieces on the kingside, launch mating attack.

subVariations.name: Dutch Defense: Stonewall Classical System
subVariations.description: Mikhail Botvinnik's iron fortress: Black establishes a rock-solid pawn chain (c6/d5/e6/f5) and attacks the kingside.
subVariations.whitePlan: Trade dark bishops with Ba3 to weaken Black's king defense, occupy e5.
subVariations.blackPlan: Defend dark squares, anchor knight on e4, attack down the f-file.

subVariations.name: Dutch Defense: Classical / Ilyin-Genevsky
subVariations.description: Alexander Ilyin-Genevsky's fluid classical system: Black breaks centrally with ...e5 and transfers the queen to h5.
subVariations.whitePlan: Pressure open d-file with Rd1, control central light squares.
subVariations.blackPlan: Transfer queen to h5 via Qe8, attack White's king with ...f4.

subVariations.name: Dutch Defense: Staunton Gambit (2.e4)
subVariations.description: Howard Staunton's gambit: White sacrifices the e4 pawn to disrupt Black's setup and prevent the Dutch pawn chain.
subVariations.whitePlan: Castle long, attack Black's king with h4/h5, exploit king centralization.
subVariations.blackPlan: Hold onto material, fianchetto bishop on h6/g7, coordinate smoothly.

subVariations.name: Trompowsky Attack (1.d4 Nf6 2.Bg5)
subVariations.description: Octavio Trompowsky's aggressive system: White attacks Black's knight on move 2, inflicting doubled f-pawns on Black.
subVariations.whitePlan: Target Black's doubled f-pawns, attack with Qh5 and Bb5.
subVariations.blackPlan: Castle queenside, utilize bishop pair, counterattack in the center with ...e5.

subVariations.name: London System: Main Line vs King's Indian
subVariations.description: The unstoppable modern London System favored by Magnus Carlsen and Ding Liren: an ironclad pyramid of pawns with Bf4.
subVariations.whitePlan: Maintain solid central pyramid, maneuver knight via e5, control the board.
subVariations.blackPlan: Fianchetto bishops on g7/b7, break with ...c5 or ...e5, target d4.

subVariations.name: London System vs Queen's Gambit Setup (1.d4 d5 2.Bf4)
subVariations.description: White establishes the famous f4/e5 outpost in the London System, creating a devastating Stonewall-style attack.
subVariations.whitePlan: Anchor knight on e5, support with f4 and Qf3, launch kingside mating attack.
subVariations.blackPlan: Counter with ...Ne7-f5, trade dark bishops, attack White's center.

subVariations.name: Torre Attack (1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 e6 3.Bg5)
subVariations.description: Carlos Torre's system: White pins the f6 knight and establishes smooth piece harmony without theoretical complexity.
subVariations.whitePlan: Control e5 square, utilize active bishop on d3, attack on kingside.
subVariations.blackPlan: Fianchetto on b7, maintain solid d6/e6 formation, counterattack on c-file.

subVariations.name: Colle System: Classical 3.e3 & 4.Bd3
subVariations.description: Edgard Colle's classic attacking weapon: White builds a solid c3/e3 base and unleashes an explosive e4 central breakthrough.
subVariations.whitePlan: Break with e4, attack kingside with Bxh7+ sacrifices (Greek Gift).
subVariations.blackPlan: Maintain active bishop on c5, counterstrike in the center with ...e5.

subVariations.name: Dutch Defense: Bellon Gambit (2.d5)
subVariations.description: White pushes 2.d5 to disrupt Black's development, met by Black's ...e5 counter-break.
subVariations.whitePlan: Control long diagonal with Bb2/Bg2, put pressure on d6.
subVariations.blackPlan: Recapture with ...Bxe6, anchor knight on c5, attack White's center.
